endpoint.value: No further sharpening of the free oleic-acid NMR signal is observed

operations.description: Independent 11-Bromoundecanoic acid exchange. Follow oleate release; quantities, duration and temperature are unreported. operations.label: Assess as-prepared oleate coverage with ferrocene
operations.description: Main p.3 describes a known ferrocene internal standard and integration of the bound-oleate resonance for as-prepared particles; standard amount is not restated. Separately, other exchanged-ligand coverage is assessed after purification and quantitative thiolate displacement, but exact per-ligand purification schedules and numerical release conditions are not supplied in the admitted main. Table1 ensemble measurements retain general-context links.

operations.label: Exchange oleate with 11-undecenylphosphonic acid
operations.description: Main p.3 reports quantitative oleate displacement by 11-undecenylphosphonic acid. Its terminal-vinyl proton signals shift slightly upfield and broaden on binding. No bound-phosphonate31P NMR signal was observed. Purification, batch identity and numerical conditions are unreported.
